mapper.sql: SELECT b.binding_id, b.connector_type, b.external_userid, b.external_name, b.mobile, b.external_job_no, b.employee_no, b.employee_id, e.employee_name AS employee_name, b.match_type, b.sync_time, b.remark, b.create_time, b.update_time FROM integration_user_binding b LEFT JOIN biz_hr_employee e ON b.employee_id = e.employee_id
mapper.select:
AND b.connector_type = #{connectorType} AND b.external_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{externalName}, '%') AND b.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{mobile}, '%') AND b.external_job_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{externalJobNo}, '%') AND b.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND b.match_type = #{matchType} AND b.employee_id IS NOT NULL AND b.employee_id IS NULL AND b.sync_time >= CONCAT(#{params.beginSyncTime}, ' 00:00:00') AND b.sync_time <= CONCAT(#{params.endSyncTime}, ' 23:59:59')
ORDER BY b.employee_id IS NULL DESC, b.external_name

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM integration_user_binding b
AND b.connector_type = #{connectorType} AND b.employee_id IS NOT NULL AND b.employee_id IS NULL
WHERE b.connector_type = #{connectorType} AND b.employee_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE integration_user_binding SET employee_id = NULL, employee_no = NULL, match_type = NULL, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE binding_id = #{bindingId}
mapper.select: SELECT b.employee_id FROM integration_user_binding b WHERE b.connector_type = #{connectorType} AND b.employee_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.employee_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
